mapper.select: SELECT mp.member_perfume_id, p.perfume_id, p.image_route, p.brand, p.perfume_name, p.price, a.accord_name FROM ( SELECT mp2.member_perfume_id, mp2.perfume_id, mp2.create_time FROM member_perfume mp2 JOIN perfume p2 ON mp2.perfume_id = p2.perfume_id WHERE mp2.member_id = #{memberId} AND mp2.is_delete = FALSE AND p2.is_delete = FALSE ORDER BY mp2.create_time DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset} ) mp JOIN perfume p ON mp.perfume_id = p.perfume_id LEFT JOIN perfume_accord pa ON p.perfume_id = pa.perfume_id AND pa.is_delete = FALSE LEFT JOIN accord a ON pa.accord_id = a.accord_id AND a.is_delete = FALSE ORDER BY mp.create_time DESC, pa.accord_order
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mp.member_perfume_id) FROM member_perfume mp JOIN perfume p ON mp.perfume_id = p.perfume_id WHERE mp.member_id = #{memberId} AND mp.is_delete = FALSE AND p.is_delete = FALSE
